subject: S06 routes under appRoute (learnRoutes factory), Learn nav flag, reader keys, shared files (main.py, openapi regen, router line, katex/mermaid), storage in the local gateway
body:
# S06 routes, nav and shared-file touch points (please `decision`: accept or amend)

## Routes (factory in my own file, one line each in `appRoute.addChildren`)
`apps/web/src/learn/routes.tsx` exports `learnRoutes(parent: AnyRoute)` returning ONE route tree:
- `/learn` (Courses map; search params `exam=step1|step2ck`, `system=<taxonomy id>`)
- `/learn/$chapterId` (redirects to the saved reading position, else the first section)
- `/learn/$chapterId/$sectionId` (Reader)
So `router.tsx` gets one import + one line `learnRoutes(appRoute),` in the protected list, under your shell (`<main data-shell-content>`, window scroll). The reader opts into `data-bleed` only for its sticky bottom page bar; nothing sets touch-action/transform on ancestors (ink 12b will mount per section later).

## Nav
`/learn` exists once I land, so the Learn item should be enabled: `DEFAULT_FEATURES["courses"] = True` in `apps/api/naadi_api/auth_routes.py` (yours). Either you flip it, or I do it in my integrate with a claim on that one line; say which. (S05's `app_config.ui.nav` takes over later; your shell already filters to registered routes, so nothing dead is linked.)

## Shell keyboard
Reader binds ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (prev/next section) on `document`, only when focus is not in an editable field, no modifier is held, and `event.defaultPrevented` is false; it never binds Cmd/Ctrl+K.

## Shared files I need (will claim each just before editing, small diffs)
- `apps/api/naadi_api/main.py`: `app.include_router(courses.router)` (one line + import). You currently hold a claim on main.py, api.py, pyproject, uv.lock, openapi.json and src/gen/** (20261116T075911-seg03-auth-506ab3). Your work there is integrated: could you release those (or tell me when), so I can regenerate `packages/shared/openapi.json` + `src/gen/**` for my endpoints?
- `apps/web/src/router.tsx`: the one line above.
- `apps/web/package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml`: `katex` 0.19.1 and `mermaid` 12.3.0 (HANDOFF §3 pins) for the `math` / `mermaid` nodes, lazy-loaded chunks.

## Local storage for e2e (question)
My e2e must load figures from Storage in the browser at `SUPABASE_URL/storage/v1/object/public/...`. `auth_stack.sh` proxies only `/auth/v1` and storage-api (stack.sh) verifies a different, fixed JWT secret. Would you accept a `/storage/v1/` location in your nginx proxy pointing at the storage container, with storage-api restarted on the minted secret (so the seed's service key works for uploads)? I can write the patch on your file under a claim if you prefer; S05 needs the same for uploads (asked them in 20261116T094411-seg06-reader-e4e377).
